name: Hall of Explorers
summary: In Ironforge, the Hall of Explorers draws the dwarves who seek their people's origins. The Explorers' League studies Azeroth's past here.

sections.title: Headquarters of the League
sections.body: In northeastern Ironforge, the Hall of Explorers fills a cavern with scholars and field agents. High Explorer Muninn Magellas directs their work as they arrange digs in distant lands. Those expeditions bring back relics, ancient titan machinery, and prehistoric bones. At the hall's center, the Library keeps historical lore. Visitors may see its displays, while other records remain restricted.

faq.q: What is the Hall of Explorers used for?
faq.answer: The Hall of Explorers is the Explorers' League headquarters and museum. Scholars study reports, catalog excavation relics, and arrange digs to learn about the dwarves' origins and ancient Azeroth.
High Explorer Muninn Magellas directs the hall's expeditions, museum, and research archives.

faq.q: How does this place connect to the rest of Ironforge?
faq.answer: The Hall of Explorers lies in northeastern Ironforge. Archways connect it to the Great Forge to the southwest, the Forlorn Cavern to the west, and Tinker Town to the south.

angles.text: As a dwarven adventurer, you can explore relics gathered here as the League seeks your people's ancient origins and their connection to the Titans.
